question.worked_solution:
Evaluating $F(x)$ at $x=\frac{\pi }{4},$ we get the following definite integral:

$$
F\,(\frac{\pi }{4})={\int }_{0}^{\pi /4}4{sec}^{2}⁡t\,\text{d}t
$$

Then, computing the definite integral, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}F\,(\frac{\pi }{4}) & ={\int }_{0}^{\pi /4}4{sec}^{2}⁡t\,\text{d}t \\  & =4\operatorname{tan}⁡t\,{|}_{0}^{\pi /4} \\  & =4(\operatorname{tan}⁡(\frac{\pi }{4})-\operatorname{tan}⁡(0)) \\  & =4(1-0) \\  & =4.\end{aligned}
$$
